dedupe_keys.name: a big data approach to the application of building performance simulation to improve the operational performance of large estates

description: Clarke, Joe and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented building-performance-simulation workflow fetches an input model, automatically calibrates it and invokes scripted cloud assessments when operational problems are observed. Stated assessment roles include HVAC fault diagnosis, upgrade appraisal, indoor-environment changes, demand reduction and renewable/control integration. The description establishes the workflow and calibration procedure within the HIT2GAP data-exchange setting. CALIBRO is a separately described calibration package; identical software or obligatory coupling is not inferred from their shared project. The abstract does not establish downloadable code, a fully operating public cloud endpoint or quantitative savings across all proposed assessments. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
